description: TfL publishes separate point layers for Underground, Elizabeth line, DLR, Overground and Tramlink stations. The service metadata identifies all five components. Layer fields include station name, network, accessibility and update date; Underground fields additionally include line, ATCO code and night-service descriptors. The item description itself is sparse, so the scope comes from the explicit service/layer metadata. These locations do not establish train schedules, platform layouts or station capacity. Coverage is Greater London. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The item metadata does not state a reuse licence. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing TfL 2023 PTAL grid.
